title: ascend-distributed-parallel
summary: Select and validate distributed parallelism strategy on Ascend NPU: topology-aware  card-group selection, USP/CP/TP/PP strategy choice, communication masking setup and  verification, attribution of parallelism gains, and diagnosis of strategies that appear  to activate but have no effect. Covers native HCCL multi-rank AllReduce dispatch, scratch and synchronization boundaries, AlltoAllV defect workaround, and source-scoped communication-test timing and correctness coverage.
